# Data Source: identitynow_lifecycle_state

Use this data source to look up a lifecycle state of an identity profile by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_lifecycle_state" "active" {
  identity_profile_id = "2b838de9-db9b-abcf-e646-d4f274ad4238"
  id                  = "ef38f94347e94562b5bb8424a56397d8"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Lifecycle state ID.
- `identity_profile_id` (String) ID of the identity profile the lifecycle state belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `access_profile_ids` (Set of String) Set of IDs of the access profiles granted in the lifecycle state.
- `account_actions_json` (String) Account actions as a JSON array.
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the lifecycle state.
- `email_notification_option` (Attributes List) Email notifications, a list with one element with `notify_managers`, `notify_all_admins`, `notify_specific_users` and `email_address_list`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_notification_option))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the lifecycle state is enabled.
- `identity_count` (Number) Number of identities in the lifecycle state.
- `identity_state` (String) Identity state associated with the lifecycle state.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Name of the lifecycle state.
- `priority` (Number) Sort order of the lifecycle state.
- `remove_all_access_enabled` (Boolean) Whether all access is marked for removal.
- `technical_name` (String) Technical name of the lifecycle state.

<a id="nestedatt--email_notification_option"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_notification_option`

Read-Only:

- `email_address_list` (List of String) Email addresses to notify.
- `notify_all_admins` (Boolean) Notify all admins.
- `notify_managers` (Boolean) Notify the manager of the identity.
- `notify_specific_users` (Boolean) Notify the users in `email_address_list`.
